subject: Contract extension & ops onboarding for premium support + latency guarantees
messages:
From: Sam Owens <sam.owens@acuityhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acuityhealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Contract extension + premium support inquiry

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you are well — we’ve been really happy with Redwood’s improvements over the last year. Usage has ramped faster than we forecasted (attached Q2 usage), and we’re planning to extend through 2027 but need to tighten our operational commitments.

Specifically, two asks from Acuity’s side:
- Move to a premium support tier (24/7 triage + named escalation path)
- Add a latency SLO for our production model: 95th percentile < 220ms, 99th percentile < 520ms (global region us-west) — we understand this may need dedicated capacity and want a recommended capacity configuration.

Can Redwood produce a short term amendment we can review? Also want an onboarding plan for the Ops team and a targeted go-live date of Sept 15 if we can finalize terms by end of month.

Attachments: usage_q2_2026.csv (summary of request volume by route)

Thanks,
Sam Owens
VP, Platform Operations
AcuityHealth
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sam Owens <sam.owens@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract extension + premium support inquiry

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear note and the usage file.

Short answer: we can support both asks, but there are a couple of moving pieces (capacity reservation, 24/7 triage staffing, and a measurable latency SLO with uptime/penalty language). I’ve looped in Karthik (solutions) and Ben (AE) to scope the capacity and pricing implications.

Proposed next steps: 
1) 30-minute call this week to align on traffic patterns and failover expectations (can you do Thu 8/20 10:00am PT?)
2) We’ll share a draft term amendment + SOW (attached) that outlines the SLOs, monitoring hooks, and escalation targets.
3) If legal is okay, we’ll send an initial DocuSign for the amendment and schedule a 2-week onboarding sprint to hit Sept 15.

I attached a first-pass draft_term_amendment_v1.pdf that includes the SLO language and a recommended Dedicated configuration (2 x 8-GPU pool + canary ratio). Pricing shown is illustrative until we confirm exact throughput.

If that timeline works, I’ll book the call and Ben will pull together the provisional commercial.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft_term_amendment_v1.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Owens <sam.owens@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Contract extension + premium support inquiry

Kim / Ben / Sam —

Thanks for the data, Sam. Quick notes from a capacity standpoint after a surface review:
- Based on the Q2 sample, recommend a dedicated pool sized for peak sustained throughput (we modeled 1.6x Q2 peak to allow headroom). That maps to the 2 x 8-GPU config Kimberly shared; we’ll validate with a short load run during the onboarding sprint.
- Canary strategy: route 10% traffic to the new pool for the first 48 hours with automatic rollback on latency regression > 15% at the 95th pct.
- Monitoring: we’ll provision an SLA dashboard that pushes 95/99th latency and tail percentile traces to your team’s Slack channel and to the Redwood Console.

Action items I’ll own if we proceed: load run script, example dashboard, and the runbook for escalation to engineering.

Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Owens <sam.owens@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@acuityhealth.com, AcuityHealth Legal <legal@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial & SOW for premium support amendment (AC-2026-0921)

Hi Sam / Acuity team —

Good to put numbers against this: attached SOW_ACuity_SLA_v1.pdf and a short commercial summary. Highlights:
- Term: 12 months extension starting 2026-09-15; 2x8-GPU Dedicated pool reserved for production.
- Premium Support: 24/7 triage (phone + Slack), 1-hour P1 response, named escalation path; includes two on-site (remote) onboarding weeks.
- SLOs: 95th < 220ms, 99th < 520ms measured at edge for us-west region.
- Pricing delta: $X/month for dedicated capacity + one-time onboarding fee (line items in the PDF).

Please review the SOW and, if okay, sign the amendment via the DocuSign link below. Once countersigned we’ll kick off the onboarding plan and book the load validation window.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC12345
Attachment: SOW_ACuity_SLA_v1.pdf

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Owens <sam.owens@acuityhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@acuityhealth.com, AcuityHealth Legal <legal@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial & SOW for premium support amendment (AC-2026-0921)

Ben / Kim / team —

Thanks — we reviewed the SOW and legal sent back two minor redlines (clarifying the rollback window and a data retention bullet). We’re OK to proceed once those are addressed. Procurement will route the DocuSign today.

Assuming we finalize by EOD Thursday (8/31), Acuity is committed to the Sept 15 start date. Please send the onboarding schedule and the first-week runbook so our ops team can reserve time.

– Sam
VP, Platform Operations
AcuityHealth
